SLIDE - Wrong group chat

Enter starts/continues. WASD or arrows move. Space jumps. Shift brakes.
R retries from your checkpoint. Escape pauses. M mutes.
Backspace restarts the course. F5 reloads its JSON and WAV files.
Page Up / Page Down scroll longer consequence recaps. Q quits from menus.

Edit assets/courses/<course>/course.json and messages.json.
Replace its audio/*.wav files with 16-bit PCM WAV tracks (mono or stereo).
No recompilation is required. Press F5 to reload the current course.
Reload/restart clears current-course history; checkpoint retry preserves it.

Touching a message card sends that message to the wrong chat.
The defeat screen explains the consequence. Enter retries.
The finish screen remembers the messages hit and avoided.

Run Slide.exe --validate to check all course assets (validation.log).
Run Slide.exe --smoke for hidden Windows rendering checks.
Keep assets/ and shaders/ beside Slide.exe when sharing.
